title: Signal: Python index marked as a trusted host
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares a host on `--trusted-host`, for which certificate validation is skipped.
limitations: It matches a host on `--trusted-host`, for which certificate validation is skipped in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions a host on `--trusted-host`, for which certificate validation is skipped in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
